note: The Floorplan Tracer driven through the runner (tools/runner/worker.mjs) from a chat: the project's whole state (projects/<CODE>/ incl. its work dir) lives in R2 at {DIR}state/; every stage pulls it, runs, and pushes it back. The agent writes scope.json (the USER's answers), reading.json and layout.json into {DIR}state/ with library.write and reads the measuring aids from {DIR}steps/aids/. Gated tasks carry the USER's approval words in args.approved — never the agent's.

T_NEW.title: Start the tracer project from a plan image (optionally cropped to the part to trace)

args.source: R2 key of the plan image, e.g. Projects/<CODE>/3-build/build-from-deck/steps/S1_INTAKE/images/<file>.png
args.title: optional

T_NEW.next: Ask the USER the scope questions (source kind, who sets the scale, what to place); write their answers to {DIR}state/scope.json (answered_by: user), then queue T_TASK { task: S0_SCOPE, approved: "<their words>" }.

T_TASK.title: Run one tracer task (S0_SCOPE … S8_REVIEW); gated ones need args.approved = the user's words

args.task: S0_SCOPE | S1_INTAKE | S2_READ | S3_DIMENSIONS | S4_LAYOUT | S5_BUILD | S6_VERIFY | S7_EXPORT | S8_REVIEW
args.approved: the USER's approval, verbatim + date (gated tasks only)

T_WALLBANDS.title: Measure wall bands, openings and columns on the project's plan image (pixels)

args.image: path inside the project, default inputs/plan.png

T_WALLBANDS.next: Read {STEPS}aids/wallbands.json and its .png (bands magenta, gaps green, columns violet) — write reading.json from them.

T_ZOOM.title: A gridded zoom crop of the project's plan image, to read doors / symbols in exact image pixels
